title: Preserve sitemap sections when the five remaining legacy readers fail on transport

source.ref: Five remaining swallowed reads named in LIVE-331 and revalidated during SCAN-1051

detail: After the scoped organizer repair, getTopicalChannels,getPublicCircles,listSitemapEventEntries,listPublicJourneys and getSpotlightRoutes/listPublishedSpotlightHandles still discard resolved transport failures or catch them as empty. LIVE331 explicitly named these as outside its closed repair. A sectionRead wrapper alone cannot help a lower reader that resolves[]; change the actual reporting boundary deliberately, preserving other callers' documented behavior and the public visibility/publish/privacy gates. Use the existing transient classifier so real PostgREST codes remain deterministic even at5xx. Keep intentional sitemap caps and their observability separate; no pagination scope expansion is inferred. Tests must drive each actual reader through a scripted SDK and the sitemap, proving healthy empty, deterministic errors and transport preservation. No migration, public privilege expansion, production outage injection or release is authorized.

verify.evidence: OPEN: source-confirmed swallowed paths remain in the five named reader chains. Close only with actual-reader and sitemap failure-path tests and compatible caller behavior, not added wrappers/comments or a green source scan. Production cache/search acceptance must stay separately identified.
